description: Off by one when counting gaps, floors or saw cuts.
Did not notice the word "not" in the question.
Answered a different question: asked how many are left, answered how many were taken.
Stopped at an intermediate result instead of finishing the solution.
Used the wrong operation: added instead of subtracting, multiplied instead of dividing.
Reversed a comparison: taller and shorter, before and after, more and less.
Counted the lucky case instead of the worst case when the answer must be certain.
Took a statement as true without checking whether the speaker may be lying.
Mixed up hours and minutes, or counted 100 minutes in an hour.
Answered with a number from the question without computing anything.
Got the parity wrong, for example thought that odd plus odd is odd.
Ignored one of the conditions, such as "different", "exactly once" or "at both ends".
